full_name: Michael F. Suarez, S.J. | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: A self-described human ping-pong ball, Michael Suarez teaches on both sides of the Atlantic: at Fordham University in New York City and at Campion Hall and the Faculty of English, Oxford University.
